Interface ResponseVisitor

All Known Implementing Classes:
AppCoordinator
public interface ResponseVisitor
Visitor interface for dispatching ServerResponse subtypes on the client side without instanceof checks. Implemented by AppCoordinator to route each incoming response to the appropriate screen or handler.
